annotations.title: DOT random drug and alcohol testing: how many, and a fair draw

description: FMCSA random testing under 49 CFR 382.305: the year's minimum tests from the average pool (50% drug, 10% alcohol for 2026), how many to select this period to stay on pace, and optionally an unbiased random selection from a list of driver IDs (use employee numbers, never names or SSNs), with a pool fingerprint.

alcoholTestsDone.description: Alcohol tests completed in earlier periods

drugTestsDone.description: Drug tests completed in earlier periods

poolIds.description: Optional: driver IDs to draw from now

poolSizes.description: Drivers in the pool for each period so far this year, including the current one

seed.description: Optional seed to make the draw reproducible for an auditor
